name: singlet_cross_species_one_to_many_ortholog_harmonization
title: Harmonize one-to-many orthologs across species
description: Combines or weights source-species gene counts that map to one shared feature, so cross-species comparisons use a documented rule. The default one_to_one keeps only unambiguous orthologs and drops multi-copy genes; sum, mean, max, select_expression, samap_graph and saturn_macrogene keep them. Writes layers/harmonized_counts and uns/harmonization_report. Do not use it to infer orthologs (see cross-species.ortholog_assignment) or to integrate cells after harmonization.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI, or a workspace handle; must hold per-species counts and obs/species.

layer.description: Count layer to harmonize; raw UMI counts over each species' source genes.

ortholog_table.description: Member holding the ortholog table with relation labels one_to_one, one_to_many, many_to_one or many_to_many.

collapse.description: Harmonization rule. one_to_one is the default baseline; prefer samap_graph or saturn_macrogene when coverage matters.

max_orthologs.description: Maximum paralogs per source gene before the gene is dropped; applies to one_to_one, sum, mean and max.

select_expression.description: Options for select_expression: the paralog is chosen on cells outside the evaluated set.

selection_split.description: Cells used to choose the paralog; must be disjoint from the cells that are evaluated.

samap.description: Options for samap_graph: reciprocal-BLAST homology graph, reweighting and row filter.

eval_threshold.description: BLAST e-value threshold for homology edges.

filter_threshold.description: Keep an edge only if it is at least this fraction of its gene's strongest edge.

tanh_centre.description: Centre of the tanh edge reweighting; SAMap uses 0.7 at two other call sites.

saturn.description: Options for saturn_macrogene; num_macrogenes has no default and must be set.

hv_genes.description: Highly variable genes kept per species before embedding.

num_macrogenes.description: Number of macrogenes, the shared features; required, no default.

embedding_model.description: Protein language model that embeds each gene's protein; no default.

seed.description: Random seed for saturn_macrogene training and the select_expression split.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. layers/harmonized_counts. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Completed runs: rule, retained_gene_fraction, n_shared_features, paralog_group_sizes. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
